title: Evidence for a question, each piece with its source
description: Returns the evidence behind a question about WoW: Forever, so an answer can cite it: player observations, curated facts, game files and the 2023 Warcraft Wiki. An observed fact is public after three installs agree and carries the install count; a game-file fact is found in game files, unconfirmed, with the build; lore is marked: may differ in Forever. Every piece carries a claim, its source URL, licence and date; the answer is evidence, not prose. Use it for questions that need citations, such as why, where or how many; use search_knowledge to find a record by name, and the page tools (item_page, npc_page, quest_page) for one entity's agreed facts. Further-reading links are search URLs on other sites; nothing is fetched from them. When Everloot's public player data is not connected, the observed layer is unrecorded, not empty.

question.description: The question, 1 to 500 characters, with names spelled as in the game.

limit.description: Most lore and curated pieces, 1 to 25, default 8.

claim.description: One short statement. Observed facts are in Everloot's words; lore is the source's own excerpt.

kind.description: observed: players' uploads, public after three installs agree. curated: Everloot's own facts. files: the WoW: Forever game files, ids and facts only, found in game files and unconfirmed, with the build. lore: the 2023 Warcraft Wiki, which may differ in WoW: Forever.

asOf.description: When the source was read, or when the observations were current.

support.description: Observed facts: how many installs reported it.

url.description: The everloot.app page for this piece, absolute: the item or NPC page, or the indexed lore page. Absent when there is none.

evidence.description: Observed first, then curated, then lore.

furtherReading.description: Search links on other sites. Nothing was fetched.

dataAsOf.description: When the observed layer was current; null when it is not connected.
